newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 21.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China issues a new set of rules governing the bankruptcy of state firms and re-employment of staff.
- Retail investors on the Shanghai stock exchange say non-standardised release of information by companies is a major source of stock market risk in China.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's garment exports hit a record high of $25 billion yuan in 1996, a rise of 4.2 percent against 1995.
